description:
Will their unrequited loves remain nothing more than mutual consolation?

On the last night of October, former model and top star actor Gong Sinjae and his manager Yeon Hosu find themselves in the exact same place, at the exact same time, under the exact same circumstances. Both are unintentionally dumped by the same person, top actor Lee Youngwon, through an unexpected public dating announcement.

Desperate to stop Youngwon’s relationship from going public, Sinjae tries to use Hosu’s position as manager, but in the end, he cannot even bring himself to try. Instead, the two end up sitting across from each other, bonded by the same heartbreak, drinking together.

After losing count of how many glasses they have emptied, Sinjae leans closer to Hosu and makes a suggestion.

*“We both got dumped without even getting to confess. Wouldn’t it be nice if we at least comforted each other?”*
